resumeText:
Rohan Deshmukh | Pune | rohan.deshmukh@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Sales Executive, Saffron Heights Developers, Pune (2022 - present)
- Conducted site visits and sample flat walkthroughs for 30 to 40 families a month at a 2 and 3 BHK project in Wakad.
- Followed up on walk-in and digital enquiries within 24 hours and scheduled revisits.
- Prepared cost sheets and booking forms and coordinated the agreement for sale registration with the legal team.
- Coordinated with tie-up banks to get home loan sanctions for buyers before the agreement date.
- Logged every enquiry, site visit and follow-up in Sell.Do CRM.
- Closed 62 bookings in FY2025 against a target of 55 units.
- Presented project amenities and payment plans to buyers in Marathi, Hindi and English.

Pre-Sales Executive, Gharkul Realty, Pune (2020 - 2022)
- Called digital leads from property portals and fixed site visit appointments for the closing team.

EDUCATION
BBA, Savitribai Phule Pune University, 2020

SKILLS
Price negotiation, MS Excel, Customer handling
